title: Trusted campaign projection

module_api.input: Raw exact F105 config schema; call validate_first_binding(config,now=now).

integration_seam.integration_changes: Integrator validates server-owned config and builds projection; adapter flattens nested accepted fields, never accepts projection from request body. Gate policy assembled by integrator.

scope_exclusions: No company fact approval or database writes
gate_closure: component acceptance does not automatically close FG
accepted_dependency_rule: Only accepted SOURCE dependencies are production imports. Pending normalizer/correlator/lease components are injected frozen protocols with self-contained fixtures. Real integration requires accepted code; no invented implementation in packet.
return_evidence_required: changedfiles SHA256 + patch only allowed paths
all own tests run exitcodes skip0
negative acceptance vectors actual expected codes
inherited accepted contracts/source tests regression results separately, no claim fullPASS withknownfailures
error_class_contract: Public module-specific ValueError subclass with stable .code:str; str(exception)==code; error message contains code only, never input/body/email/token/SQL/credentials. Injected sameTXguard errors explicitly mapped by F115 contract.
